HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: A Heathen is asked to carve a new mark on the camp's memorial post for an elder long gone.

description_variants.description: An Isolan is asked to carve a new mark on the camp's memorial post for an elder long gone.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: There is a wooden post at the centre of the encampment covered in small carvings: a fish, a hand, a crescent, a spiral. Each one stands for someone the camp has lost. (subject) has been asked to add a new one, for an elder who passed long before most of the camp's children were born and has never had a mark of (other.his/her) own.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) goes round the camp asking everyone what they remember of the elder. The answers are all different. (subject) carves a bird with its wings open, because three people mentioned that she whistled. Everyone agrees it is exactly right, though nobody can say why.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) carves late into the night without asking anyone. In the morning there is a small, plain circle on the post. Some people think it is unfinished. The oldest Heathen at the camp looks at it for a long while and says it is the best one on the post.
